critiques.assumption: A manifest and verifier can establish the intended historical course set.
critiques.limitation: Timetable completeness is unmeasured; current assignments represent historical weeks. Agreement may repeat one mistaken source. Actual shared-source failure remains conjectural.
critiques.opening: Make disagreement resolution assessable before building automatic release assurance.
critiques.comparison: A1 detects manifest/file disagreement; Z1/Z2 investigate membership. Neither establishes an independent production expectation.
critiques.probe: Proposed: give manifest and selector the same fabricated historical error and test whether an independently specified expectation exposes it.

critiques.assumption: Faster replacement delivery materially reduces measured handling time.
critiques.limitation: D1-O5 measures waiting; D1-O7 leaves spreadsheet actions unobserved. An unchanged rerun may reproduce the mismatch.
critiques.opening: Choose the recovery action from the diagnosed mismatch and measure active effort separately.
critiques.comparison: A2 accelerates retrieval; Z1 distinguishes selection from recognition. Their interaction could avoid unnecessary reruns; mistaken classification defeats it.
critiques.probe: Proposed: compare active handling and elapsed delay for recognition-only and missing-course scenarios.

openings.claim: A private adjudication view could expose conflicts among intended membership, current assignments, and exported course identities.
openings.delta: Expose unresolved provenance instead of treating agreement as correctness.
openings.prediction: Deliberately shared errors remain unresolved until independent expectations are supplied.
openings.probe: Proposed fabricated reassignment, rename, and split fixtures; record coordinator effort to resolve each conflict.
openings.fit: Preserves outcome; no automatic historical assurance without independent evidence.
assumptions: Inspect stable identities first; historical records and affordable private display remain unestablished.

openings.claim: Diagnosis could route recognition failures to private identity clarification and selection failures to a corrected authorized rerun.
openings.delta: Z1 supplies the recovery decision; A2 supplies delivery. Neither alone connects cause to action.
openings.prediction: Correctly classified rename cases need fewer replacement requests; unchanged selection logic remains a failure boundary.
openings.probe: Proposed paired coordinator sessions; measure checking, correction, download, import, and waiting separately.
openings.fit: Select one bounded prototype within six engineer-days and existing hosting; retain private names, documented CSV, and concurrent attendance entry. No tests performed; 40-export targets remain unverified.
assumptions: Diagnosis and corrected selection are available cheaply; otherwise assess routing only.
